sentences.text: Vescimonas fastidiosa was proposed from strains of Gram-stain-negative, obligately anaerobic, non-spore-forming, non-motile rods isolated from human faeces.
On phylogenetic characteristics the isolates were included in the family Ruminococcaceae.
The six isolates showed 16S rRNA gene sequence similarity below 96.2 percent to the closely related species Oscillibacter ruminantium, Oscillibacter valericigenes and Dysosmobacter welbiomis.
The type strain of Vescimonas fastidiosa is strain MM35, deposited as JCM 34016 and DSM 111899.
A 12-week randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of a postbiotic preparation in healthy adults reported reductions in Vescimonas fastidiosa among gut microbiota changes.
